{{Quote|The Council was sending her on her first diplomatic mission&hellip; to Sevarcos, I think it was. She came to ask my advice. She had striking eyes, very gray and steady.|Count Dooku|<ref name="YDR" />}}
The '''mission to Sevarcos II''' was a diplomatic mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]] assigned to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jang Li-Li]]. It was her first diplomatic mission as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and prior to leaving, she asked [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], a senior [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], for advice.<ref name="YDR" />
